messages:
mike (eng-security): heads up — after last night's key rotation some /v1/embed routes accepted old tokens for ~2h. Not sure if it's KMS cache vs authz lookup. repro + logs below.

jess (eng-platform): oh no. can you paste the exact curl + request_id and which key was rotated? we need to scope blast radius.

mike (eng-security): repro steps:
1) rotate key: `kms rotate --id=key-prod-1` at ~2024-11-03T02:12Z
2) send embed request using previous token (header kept from session)

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_old_XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"ok"}'

response: 200 OK (embedding returned)   request_id=rcq-20241103-abc123

log excerpt:
```
authz: evaluate route_allowlist [route=/v1/embed] -> allowed_scopes=[embeddings]
token: scopes=[embeddings], kid=k1xxx, issued_at=1709999000
active_kid for key-prod-1 = k2yyy
result: allowed=true  // <-- suspicious: kid mismatch but allowed
```

mike (eng-security): audit shows ~240 similar requests between 02:12 and 04:10 UTC where token.kid != active_kid but auth allowed.

li (eng-sre): can you grep for `route_allowlist.cache` hits? maybe per-route allowlist uses in-memory cache keyed by kid and didn't get invalidated on rotate. also any feature flags toggled?

ana (typo fixed) ana (eng-runtime): probable root cause: rotation pipeline invalidates KMS metadata cache but the route-to-scope index in runtime is keyed by model+kid in one codepath; rotate event only cleared kid-metadata, not route-index entries. i'll sketch a hotfix: ensure rotation events publish `auth:invalidate-route-cache` and runtime subscribes to evict route-index entries for that kid.

kms-bot: rotation completed for key-prod-1 at 2024-11-03T02:12:08Z. old_kid=k1xxx new_kid=k2yyy.

auditsvc: audit note: flagged 240 requests with kid!=active_kid but auth decision=ALLOW. creating ticket SEC-4321 and appending request_ids.

jess (eng-platform): mitigation plan: 1) quick runtime guard: reject any token where token.kid != active_kid (safe stopgap), 2) emit eviction event from KMS rotation pipeline, 3) backfill audit + notify affected customers if scope/tenant mix occurred. can ana own the runtime guard? i'll own coordination w/ legal if customer outreach needed.

ana ana (eng-runtime): i'll land guard in next 45m: non-breaking config flag `auth.require_kid_match=true` off by default, flip on after smoke. will also add eviction subscription.

mike (eng-security): thanks. i'm dumping incident notes to the sec-inc folder and will include the audited request_ids. tagging @auditsvc to attach logs to SEC-4321. :thumbsup:

li (eng-sre): once guard is up, i'll run canary and watch latency/5xxs. also will monitor `authz.reject.kid_mismatch` metric.

mike (eng-security): noted. follow-ups: postmortem (why rotation event didn't cascade), add unit tests for rotation->eviction, and tighten observability for route-index invalidation.

jess (eng-platform): good. thanks everyone. keeping this open until SEC-4321 closed. :eyes:
